title: Smoke Bomb
body:
Syntax: smoke bomb <target>

Description: Attaches a consumed Smoke Bomb. After two combat pulses it deals 5-12 damage and blinds the target unless disabled. Requires a carried smoke bomb. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 30. Costs 30 Chakra and 12 Stamina; 7 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
